assumptions.statement: The organiser did not supply statutory redlines, detailed control plans, building inventory, ownership, heritage-control geometry, roads, utilities, fire or flood-control conditions.
assumptions.impact: Related metrics are unknown. Reference estimates are low-confidence capacity studies only and must be recalculated when official information is available.

assumptions.statement: The user-confirmed Shapefile is used consistently as the project working boundary but is not presented as an official statutory boundary.
assumptions.impact: Spatial design remains eligible as conceptual work; statutory use and precise control calculation require official confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Conceptual renderings may infer building height, facade and detailed site conditions from satellite imagery and photographs.
assumptions.impact: Renderings communicate design intent only and are not existing-condition survey evidence.

assumptions.statement: Specific rights holders, property managers, operators, technical owners and professional reviewers have not been appointed at concept stage.
assumptions.impact: No pilot may open until all accountable roles are named and the four-stage entry gate in the proposal is documented. This is a future trigger, not evidence of current implementation.

assumptions.statement: The proposal's coordinating entity and responsibility tables are a recommended concept-stage governance model. No management committee, public authority, approval route, procurement route or performance owner is claimed to have been established or authorised.
assumptions.impact: All real institutions, duties, approvals, procurement and performance procedures must be confirmed through statutory authority and executed agreements before a pilot can change from HOLD to PASS.

assumptions.statement: No bill of quantities, site connection survey, supplier quotations or operating contract was supplied.
assumptions.impact: The proposal provides broad low-confidence capital, operating and cost-recovery ranges for scale comparison only. Cost confirmation begins after sites and operators are selected and requires a bill of quantities, three quotations and a life-cycle cost review.

assumptions.statement: Implementation quantities, electrical loads, network capacity, programme, capital cost, operating cost and benefit ranges are inferred from the S/M/L/XL concept family and adaptive-reuse strategy rather than measured site data.
assumptions.impact: All ranges are non-statutory and non-contractual. They exclude land acquisition, major structural reinforcement, large utility expansion and specialist heritage restoration, and must be recalculated after survey and professional design.

assumptions.statement: Operational performance targets beyond accountability and safety gates require a real pilot baseline.
assumptions.impact: Demand response, repeat use, participation and conversion targets will be calibrated after the first 90-day pilot rather than fabricated in advance.
